title: Network Anomaly Detection System (FYP)
summary: A Final Year Project system that simulates SDN network traffic, detects anomalies with GNN and XGBoost models, and runs an automated benchmark/evaluation pipeline across multiple attack scenarios. Its backend uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluate_quality to train a CTGAN model and generate synthetic samples (e.g. per label/class) for the anomaly-detection pipeline.
